composition_strategy: A central-focal composition with a diagonal flow to guide the viewer's eye through the scene, creating a sense of movement and balance. The design features a subtle accent with a quiet right region paired with a quiet left region, maintaining a calm visual region.
focal_strategy: The focal point is positioned in the right lower vertical band, ensuring it stands out distinctly against the calm right region. This placement aligns with the central-focal composition family, emphasizing a clear and dominant subject.
depth_strategy: A shallow depth plan is employed to keep the scene unified and to maintain focus on the central subject. This strategy avoids distractions and ensures the main elements are well-defined.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: The perimeter remains open, allowing the focal point to naturally extend into the background, thereby creating a sense of continuity and space.
title_safe_region_strategy: The title is placed in a title-safe region at the top of the composition, ensuring legibility and prominence.
programme_safe_region_strategy: The programme information is situated in a programme-safe region in the lower part of the composition, ensuring it does not interfere with the focal point or overall composition.

short_design_rationale: This design emphasizes a clear central focal point with diagonal movement to guide the viewer's eye. The shallow depth plan and open perimeter contribute to a sense of unity and calm, while the placement of the title and programme information ensures legibility and prominence.
